role.description: A role key to look at the app as. A key that names no role is not an error: the answer says `role_known: false` and grants nothing.
role.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused.

user.description: An app user of this app, to look at the app as that user's role. A user of another app answers `404`.
